name: orient_upright
comment: body upright at a 14-bit heading (low 2 bits dropped): quaternion via matrix_to_quat renormalised through the reciprocal table; rotation matrix; momenta kept (car_put_back_on_road; body_init)

name: traffic_spawner_behind
comment: spawner entity (state 0 -> 1): while traffic is under its limit and the camera car within *0x03006258: counts +0xA0 down and spawns traffic kind 0 (section start; half speed)

name: traffic_spawner_ahead
comment: as traffic_spawner_behind with traffic kind 2 (section start; full speed)

name: spawner_handlers
comment: (tentative) entity handler 0x28; the thunks 0x0814A9C0 (0x2A: traffic_spawner_ahead) and 0x0814A9D4/0x0814A9E0 (0x2D/0x2E: traffic_spawner_behind) sit inside it; no Carbon race creates such entities

name: non_racer_car_hit
comment: car-to-car hit of a non-racer: when 0x03006174 is set and it is not the first entity the other car's +0x4B8 = 0x40; clears 0x030061F0
